svg.title: Strands Sentinel architecture
svg.desc: A two-tier architecture in which a Strands agent converts natural-language intent into an approved, validated rule, while a deterministic runtime continuously evaluates live signals and sends actionable alerts.

g.text: Natural-language intent becomes a verified rule, then a low-cost event engine watches until action matters.
Live pre-flight probe and baseline verification
Compiles intent into typed rules and condition trees
Retries, visibility renewal and DLQ path

svg.text: STRANDS SENTINEL · TYPESCRIPT MONOREPO · EXPO CLIENT · FASTIFY API · STRANDS AGENTS SDK · AMAZON BEDROCK
